text:
sophie_marketing: Heads up — embargoed benchmark + product blog scheduled for release Mon Apr 6 16:00 PT / 23:00 UTC. Need to confirm syndication window and localization handoff for APAC partners. Who owns the pickup for translations?

nate_pr: Noted. We have requests from two EU outlets asking for a slightly earlier window (22:30 UTC). Can we keep a 30m buffer for any last-minute change?

anita_legal: Please re-share the embargo text. Legal will re-clear at T-48h; last check was for technical accuracy only. No red flags so far.

liam_growth: For syndication: primary window should be 23:00–23:30 UTC. If EU needs 22:30, we can allow controlled pre-release for up to 3 vetted outlets. Need list of outlets now.

maya_intl: APAC localization team can turn around simplified Chinese and Japanese in ~6 hours if we send final copy by 09:00 PT on release day. That means content must be frozen by 03:00 PT. Is that feasible?

sophie_marketing: Good call. Freeze deadlines: content freeze 03:00 PT, final assets to translations by 09:00 PT, syndication window 23:00 UTC with a 30m grace. EU pre-release 22:30 UTC allowed for 3 partners (list below).

nate_pr: List for EU pre-release: techdaily.co, infra-weekly.eu, and devbeat. I'll DM the press ops contacts and get commitments to embargo.

pressops_bot: Reminder: embargoed release checklist not complete — tasks pending: legal sign-off, final build link, image alt text, tracking params. See /release-checklist 2 items remaining.

anita_legal: Confirmed legal sign-off pending on minor attribution line. I'll drop a comment on the doc in 20m.

liam_growth: Quick publish snippet I recommend we share with partners (copy/paste):
```
Publish timing: 2026-04-06 23:00 UTC (primary)
Syndication window: 23:00–23:30 UTC
EU pre-release: 22:30 UTC for approved outlets only
APAC localization freeze: final copy by 03:00 PT
Tracking: utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=bench-release-apr
```

maya_intl: Can ops provide a short FAQ for partners on which assets are allowed to be reposted (graphs vs raw numbers)? We need that for translations too.

sophie_marketing: Yes — I'll draft a short partner FAQ and include allowed images (PNG only), captions, and the one-sentence embargo notice. Will post here when ready.

nate_pr: Once FAQ is up, I'll send to EU contacts and loop in marketplace partners in APAC. Also flagging that one outlet in ANZ wants an interview slot; we should confirm a spokesperson.

liam_growth: Who can take the ANZ interview? @carmen_ceo maybe for high-level, or @dev_lead for deep technical. Carmen's calendar looks tight.

sophie_marketing: I'll ping Carmen and Dev lead. If neither available, Nate can do a short brief.

pressops_bot: Action items summary (auto): [sophie_marketing — partner FAQ], [anita_legal — final sign-off], [maya_intl — confirm TLs for CN/JP], [nate_pr — EU list + ANZ interview ops]. ETA T-24h.

nate_pr: :thumbsup: I'll start outreach now and post confirmations in this thread.

sophie_marketing: Thanks team. Posting the final release schedule (will edit live if anything shifts). Keep this thread as single source for partner comms.
